Amplify Education | Remote (US) | Multiple roles | https://amplify.com/careers/

We’re looking for innovators and optimists to join us in developing next-generation curriculum and assessment programs for K–12 schools. We have become a leader in K–12 literacy, biliteracy, math, and science by building inspiring teaching and learning experiences based on research.

Roles include:

* Senior Software Engineer | Remote (US) | $140K – $160K + bonus

* Software Engineer | Remote (US) | $120K – $129K + bonus

* Data Scientist | Remote (US) | $100K – $132K + bonus

* Associate Data Scientist | Remote (US) | $95K – $110K + bonus

* Director, Business Systems Technology | Remote (US) | $160K – $180K + bonus + equity

* Development Manager (ERP / HCM) | Remote (US) | $140K – $160K + bonus + equity

Apply at https://amplify.com/careers/ or email me via my profile.
